headline: Burkina Faso Opens $66 Million Nuclear and Aerospace Engineering Academy
summary: Burkina Faso President Ibrahim Traore launched a $66 million state-funded academy to train engineers in nuclear technology, aeronautics, and mining to decrease foreign reliance.
why: Burkina Faso is a major West African gold producer, and national technical workforce development targets domestic resource control and mining efficiency.

impacts.name: Burkina Faso
impacts.why: Domestic state investment in specialized industrial training aims to enhance technological independence.
